items.why: On-demand HGX B200 dedicated inference rate rose from $8.99/hr to $9.29/hr (+3%); separate from the existing image-generation price-cut record.

record.short: Together AI raised its on-demand HGX B200 dedicated inference rate from $8.99/hr to $9.29/hr.
record.headline: Together AI raised the on-demand price of its HGX B200 GPU from $8.99/hr to $9.29/hr, and began posting an on-demand rate for HGX H200 where the page used to say Contact us.
record.who: Buyers of on-demand dedicated GPU inference capacity at list price; Reserved tiers still say Contact sales.
record.read: A small list-price rise on hardware already priced, alongside posted rates for newer GPUs, suggests demand for current-generation capacity is firm. The GPU Clusters page reportedly moved too, but only the B200 on-demand rate is cited here.

items.why: GPT Image model cost doubled from 2 to 4 credits per image, halving monthly image allowances (Starter 300→150, Creator 1,300→650).

record.short: Pika’s GPT Image model now costs 4 credits per image instead of 2, so Starter drops from 300 to 150 images and Creator from 1,300 to 650 per month.
